headShape.definition:
SELECT "position" AS generation,
    entry_digest AS head_digest,
    plan_digest,
    jsonb_extract_path_text(payload, VARIADIC ARRAY['plan'::text, 'toBundleDigest'::text]) AS bundle_digest,
    jsonb_extract_path_text(payload, VARIADIC ARRAY['plan'::text, 'next'::text, 'sourceDigest'::text]) AS source_digest,
    jsonb_extract_path_text(payload, VARIADIC ARRAY['plan'::text, 'next'::text, 'configurationDigest'::text]) AS configuration_digest,
    jsonb_extract_path(payload, VARIADIC ARRAY['witness'::text]) AS native_witness
   FROM g03s_87383bea92.umf_lifecycle_history
  ORDER BY "position" DESC
 LIMIT 1;
